title: Vehicle begins route at start_index 0
description: A vehicle anchored at start_index 0 serves one job.
expectedResult: 200; status Ok; result.code==0; J1 assigned; result.unassigned empty

title: Vehicle starts at the last valid location index (boundary)
description: start_index set to len(location)-1 is accepted as the last valid anchor.
expectedResult: 200; status Ok; result.code==0; J1 assigned; result.unassigned empty

title: Open start when start_index and start_depot_ids are omitted
description: With no start anchor the vehicle starts at its first task (open start).
expectedResult: 200; status Ok; result.code==0; J1 and J2 assigned; result.unassigned empty

title: Closed route returns to its origin depot
description: end_index equal to start_index forces the vehicle back to its origin.
expectedResult: 200; status Ok; result.code==0; J1 assigned; route ends at location_index 0 (== start_index)

title: Route ends at a distinct end depot
description: end_index differing from start_index terminates the route at another location.
expectedResult: 200; status Ok; result.code==0; J1 assigned; route ends at location_index 2

title: Open route when end_index is omitted
description: Omitting end_index yields an open route that ends at the last served task.
expectedResult: 200; status Ok; result.code==0; J1 assigned; open route (no fixed end) ends at last task

title: Delivery within a single-dimension capacity
description: A delivery below capacity keeps onboard load within the bound.
expectedResult: 200; status Ok; result.code==0; J1 assigned; onboard load <= 100 at every step

title: Demand exactly equal to capacity is feasible (boundary)
description: A delivery equal to capacity is at-the-limit and still assignable.
expectedResult: 200; status Ok; result.code==0; J1 assigned; onboard load == 50 (<= capacity)

title: Multi-dimension capacity within both bounds
description: A 2-D capacity with a 2-D delivery within both dimensions is accepted.
expectedResult: 200; status Ok; result.code==0; J1 assigned; onboard load <= [10,100] on both dimensions

title: Route completes within a comfortable shift
description: A 09:00-17:00 shift comfortably contains the route.
expectedResult: 200; status Ok; result.code==0; J1 assigned; route end <= 61200

title: Feasible route inside a tight shift window
description: A short 09:00-10:00 shift still contains a single nearby job.
expectedResult: 200; status Ok; result.code==0; J1 assigned; route end <= 36000

title: Route end bounded by the shift end (boundary)
description: The whole route must finish no later than time_window[1].
expectedResult: 200; status Ok; result.code==0; J1 assigned; route end <= 43200

title: Job served at a valid location index
description: A job referencing an in-range location_index is served.
expectedResult: 200; status Ok; result.code==0; J1 assigned; result.unassigned empty

title: Job at the last valid location index (boundary)
description: location_index == len(location)-1 is the last valid reference.
expectedResult: 200; status Ok; result.code==0; J1 assigned; result.unassigned empty

title: Multiple jobs at distinct valid indices
description: Several jobs each reference a distinct in-range index and are served.
expectedResult: 200; status Ok; result.code==0; J1, J2, J3 assigned; result.unassigned empty

title: Single-dimension delivery within capacity
description: A delivery [1] on capacity [4] is served within the bound.
expectedResult: 200; status Ok; result.code==0; J1 assigned; onboard load <= 4 at every step

title: Delivery equal to capacity is feasible (boundary)
description: A delivery equal to capacity is at-the-limit and served.
expectedResult: 200; status Ok; result.code==0; J1 assigned; onboard load == 4 (<= capacity)

title: Multi-dimension delivery consistent with capacity
description: A 2-D delivery matches a 2-D capacity and stays within both bounds.
expectedResult: 200; status Ok; result.code==0; J1 assigned; onboard load <= [10,10] on both dimensions

title: Job with a setup time is served within the shift
description: A job carrying a 60s setup time is served; setup counts toward elapsed time.
expectedResult: 200; status Ok; result.code==0; J1 assigned; route end <= 61200

title: Zero setup time is accepted (boundary)
description: A setup of 0 seconds is a valid at-the-limit value.
expectedResult: 200; status Ok; result.code==0; J1 assigned; result.unassigned empty

title: Two jobs at the same location each carry setup
description: Two jobs sharing a location_index are both served; setup is applied once per location.
expectedResult: 200; status Ok; result.code==0; J1 and J2 assigned; route end <= 61200
